intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Littleton for 2026, and here is what he found: 16 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 15 (Letter to Santa) through January 3, 2027 (Hudson Holidays and Trail of Lights), with the Candlelight Walk (November 27), Pancakes with Santa (December 5) and Holiday's Evening at Littleton Museum (December 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Littleton

  • 16 Christmas events for kids in Littleton, including 3 cards that moved over from our Denver page
  • 4 free events, including Letter to Santa and the Holiday Open House
  • Meet Santa: Pet Night with Santa, Pancakes with Santa, Santa and Cocoa with Mrs. Claus at Aspen Grove and Booked for the Holidays: A Visit with Santa
  • Lights: Trail of Lights (November 21 to January 3), Hudson Holidays and the Candlelight Walk
  • Season: November 15, 2026 to January 3, 2027
